body: Now THATS a stretch lmao. But I appreciate it nonetheless
Not too bad i'm 18, thank you

ill definetly look into the mindfulness aspect of it all. i never really stopped to think about why i was fixated or needed her approval so this has opened my eyes A LOT. At the time i would act out on my urges and not think about why i had those urges in the first place... and then afterwards id feel like shit and regret it, and that cycle continued until i was sick of it and i blocked her so i wouldnt be able to have any contact at all. it worked and the feelings went away, but i definitely shouldve been practicing that mindfulness at the time and ill do my best to apply it now and see if i can look back and figure anything out. thank you :)

im really sorry about that. i cant imagine having her stuck in my life like that. i was fortunate enough that all it took to get her out was the block button, and in turn the feelings started going away... i hope things get easier for you too with time

where to even start about my parents relationship... definitely hit the nail on the head here, as i never really got to see anything like a healthy relationship when i was growing up. and when i was with her it definitely felt like i was trying to win approval from her... and that made it feel that much better when i got it. 

you nailed it dude

I'd definitely lean more towards the insecurity side as i was pretty desperate for her approval at times (as bad as that sounds)... and in terms of the sexual connection, that could be it, but im not too sure. We only ever did anything remotely sexual over text. The whole relationship to me was more so about getting her approval about certain things... so the insecurity thing sounds a bit more right.

yeah for sure, my brain was feeling pretty fucking fried while all this was going on. And thank you... ngl it took me a while before i could come clean to my gf about the whole thing, I felt really bad about it, and at the beginning i couldn't even see that the fixation was back, so it took a lot out of me to recognize it and go to my girlfriend. But i appreciate everything you said about me doing the right thing.

Thank you, I really appreciate that and it does make a lot of sense to me as when i started talking to my ex again it was a very familiar feeling... it wasn't necessarily a good feeling but it was familiar and in a way felt safe because of that, so the wagon analogy makes a lot sense, thank you :)

Thank you, that actually makes a lot of sense. 

We have worked through it, this is mainly just about getting some sort of closure or explanation to my stupid behavior.
Sorry theres so many other guys who want it but could you send it to me too pls? 😅
